data.name: Jamuh
data.gender_notes: Jamuh is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jamuh is derived from the Arabic root word 'J-M-H', meaning 'to gather' or 'community'. In Islamic history, Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) used the term 'Jamah' to describe the collective Muslim ummah. This name is a reminder of the unity and bond among the Muslim community. The name Jamuh carries the meaning “Gathering, Community” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jamuh usually hope their child will grow to embody gathering, community and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Jamuh represents unity, community, and togetherness. It is believed that those named Jamuh will be blessed with the ability to bring people together and create a strong bond among them.
data.etymology: Jamuh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gathering, Community.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jamuh total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: جموح

in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم الجموح في اللغة العربية يعني الجماعة أو المجموعة من الناس أو الأشياء، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع بمعنى الجمع والتجميع. وله أهمية كبيرة في التراث الإسلامي كونه يدل على الوحدة والتلاحم.

in_urdu.name: جموع
in_urdu.meaning: جموع کا مطلب ہے گروہ یا لوگوں یا چیزوں کا مجموعہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: عربی زبان کی root ج م ع سے بننے والا نام جموع، اردو میں بھی اسی معنی میں استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ یہ نام گروہ یا لوگوں کے مجموعے کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ اسلامی تقویم میں اس کا اہم کردار ہے کیونکہ یہ اتحاد اور ملاپ کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: जमूह
in_hindi.meaning: जमूह का अर्थ है समूह या लोगों या वस्तुओं का संग्रह

in_pashto.name: جموج
